songfinder-dev-songfinder-skills-harmoni.description: Find a song's BPM, musical key and Camelot code, and build beatmatched or harmonically compatible playlists and DJ sets. Use when the user asks how fast a track is, what key it is in, whether two songs mix together, what to play next after a given track, or asks for a set list, a transition, or tracks that sound similar to something. Also covers energy, danceability and valence for playlist curation.

songfinder-dev-songfinder-skills-identif.description: Identify what song is playing in a video, a link, or an audio file — the "what song is this?" question. Use when the user shares a YouTube/TikTok/Instagram/SoundCloud/Bilibili/X link and asks what the music is, points at an audio or video file on disk and asks to name the track, or asks you to find a song they can only describe by where they heard it. Also covers looking up a known song's ISRC, album, label, release date and Spotify/Apple Music links.
